Unconfirmed service: the repository declares cockroach (cockroachdb/cockroach:latest-v24.3) in dev/docker-compose.yaml; redpanda (docker.redpanda.com/redpandadata/redpanda:v24.3.6) in dev/docker-compose.yaml; elastic (elasticsearch:7.14.2) in dev/docker-compose.yaml; redis (redis:8.0.2-alpine3.21) in dev/docker-compose.yaml. Deployz did not find how the application uses it.

Final review: Huly is a stack of many cooperating application services (account, front, collaborator, stream, media, preview, link-preview and more) plus CockroachDB and Redpanda/Kafka, which Deployz cannot run as one web process.
